proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists Bashkarik äyĩ this under ayam, alongside the comparable Middle Indo-Aryan ayaṁ/iaṁ forms. These glottal-onset and vowel variants match that directly attested Bashkarik form; they are not assigned simply by similarity to Hindi yah.
